name: SplitScreenScroll
description: A pinned two-column story inside its own smooth-scroll viewport: as you scroll, the text column travels up while the gradient visual column travels down, so each heading meets its paired visual mid-screen, with a progress divider and counter between them.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrow/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the edges wheel events are released to the page, and touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Text panels are an ordered list of real headings and paragraphs, with aria-current="step" on the active panel; the visual column, divider and counter are decorative and aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted (columns follow native scrolling only).

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.default: ['Capture the idea', 'Shape the system', 'Prototype in motion', 'Ship with confidence', 'Learn and iterate']
propsApi.description: Panel titles; each item pairs a text panel with a gradient visual panel.

propsApi.name: palette
propsApi.description: Colors cycled through the visual panels; each panel blends its color into the next.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for panel numbers and the divider progress fill.

propsApi.name: reverse
propsApi.description: Swap directions so the text column moves down and the visual column moves up.

propsApi.name: showCounter
propsApi.description: Show the center progress divider and the 01 / 05 counter.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
